proposition: In the level-six reading of Q 54:1 the R. Shaqq-i Qamar says that raqam (writing) is identical to qamar (moon) on the basis of the letters, so that the written form is what makes the moon-splitting readable as the emergence of meaning.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
